concept.title: Importing and Exporting an Application
concept.shortdesc: The Import function imports a previously exported App into the instance to which you are connected.

note.p: Importing and Exporting an application is not supported in Essentials Edition.

conbody.p: X-Author for Excel Apps can be easily migrated from one instance to another provided that the objects being used in the exporting org match those in the importing instance.
